0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Sigun Ul is looking for fun.

48.original: Mortals in our village, how exciting! Tell me, what is your name?

49.original: <hex:022903EB0203>, a lovely name. But <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> names are lovely too!

50.original: Ah, but here's an idea! I want you to go and speak with my fellows. Ask them what their names mean. When you're done, return hither and we'll have some fun. Tee hee hee!

51.original: Go around the village and ask my fellows what their names mean. When you're done, return hither and we'll have some fun!

52.original: You wish to know the meaning of my name? Well, Jul is yew and Feo is treasure! Together it means “a treasure beneath the yew”! Beautiful, even if I do say so myself!

53.original: Remember, Jul is yew and Feo is treasure! Together it means “a treasure beneath the yew”! Beautiful, even if I do say so myself!

54.original: My name is Iala Sul. Separately, the words mean the turn of the seasons and flower. Together, they make me “a flower that blooms always.” Precious, I'm sure you'll agree.

55.original: A flower that blooms always─that is my name in your tongue. Precious, I'm sure you'll agree.

56.original: I'm Aenc Uin! Water and happiness! Happiness in the water! And I'm very happy now! Why? Because you're here! Oh, how shall we play? There are so many ways!

57.original: Water and happiness! Happiness in the water! Oh, I'll think of a game for us to play soon! And then we'll have a jolly good time!

58.original: Welcome back! I hope you were paying attention to my fellows, because I'm going to test you on the meaning of our names!

59.original: First question! Who is the pixie whose name means a treasure beneath the yew?

60.original: Which pixie's name means a treasure beneath the yew?

64.original: I see, I see... Right, second question. The pixie whose name means a flower that blooms always─where were they playing?

65.original: Where was a flower that blooms always?

69.original: Boo, you got <hex:021A020203>both<hex:021A020103> answers wrong! But I'm a kind pixie, so I'll give you another chance. Go and speak with my fellows once more, and this time mark their words well, yes?

70.original: Hmmm, one out of two isn't terrible, I suppose. All right, by way of a reward, I shall tell you more about our names!

71.original: Huzzah, you got both answers correct! You were clearly paying attention, and by way of a reward, I shall tell you more about our names!

72.original: You see, our names are composed of special runes of power. They are chosen to best represent our nature, and the spark of life that abides in us.

73.original: If I were to name you by our custom, it would be... Ooh, this is a tough one! Sigun Tyr, perhaps...or Ul Tyr─it really could go either way!

74.original: You wish to know the meaning, do you? Ah, but where's the fun in just telling you? You'll have to find out for yourself! Tee hee!
